summary: First Choice Healthcare Solutions, Inc. entered a Business Combination Agreement on July 22, 2026 with Westin Acquisition Corp. (Parent), a Cayman entity, and its wholly owned subsidiary, First Choice Acquisition Corp. Parent will domesticate as Nevada corporation Wellgevity 360, Inc. and Merger Sub will merge into the Company, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The Company is valued at up to ~$650 million equity value. Concurrently, the Company agreed to acquire all outstanding equity of four Pointe Med Entities, closing substantially concurrently. The filing is an 8-K under Item 1.01. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory conditions; risk-arb centers on merger completion and valuation certainty.
